validation_rules: prediction_id must be unique within a fixture set
derived_from must reference an existing validated mechanism identifier
observable_metric.measurement_type must use an allowed value
predicted_outcome and alternative_outcome must be non-empty and different
falsification_condition must specify a failure criterion before evaluation
minimum_required_data.replicates must be an integer greater than or equal to 1
private markers and raw transcript markers are rejected
acceptance_criteria: identical predicted and alternative outcomes fail
falsification_route: The validator is invalid if it accepts predictions that cannot fail, predictions without measurable observables, predictions with unresolved mechanism references, or non-public prediction records.
